name: Hot Potato Battleground
review:
Hot Potato: Battleground is a 7x7 cluster-pays slot set in a chaotic army camp, with cell multiplier upgrades and five feature symbols.

Thunderkick rates it High volatility, with a 10,000x cap. The published RTP is 94.23%.

Cell multipliers upgrade where wins land, so a busy area of the grid becomes more valuable. The five feature symbols each disrupt the camp differently, keeping the 7x7 board unpredictable.
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
